[[File:Breaking-Dead-Logo.png|alt=Bold yellow text on a green backsplash that reads 'Breaking Dead'|thumb|500x500px|Breaking Dead Logo]]

==Description==
Introducing Breaking Dead - the first expansion of Graveyard Keeper!
Create an army of [[Zombie|undead workers]] that automate chores around your Graveyard!

===What to Expect===

*Automate gathering of stone, wood, and have zombies craft your items.
*Taking care of your graveyard's garden has never been easier when zombies do it for you.
*Create logistics chains where zombies automate sale of [[Crates|merchandise,]] for extra profit.
*Modify and upgrade your zombies (they might need better organs) to make them more efficient.

==Other Info==
*You can start the DLC by entering the [[morgue]] at any point after the fourth {{Day|Gluttony}}; a new save is not required.
*The Steam version of the DLC is a free expansion and part of the base-game.<ref name=":Steam News Release Post">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151966726</ref>
*On all other versions of the game, Breaking Dead is a paid DLC and not a part of the base-game. ''As of May 2024'' the Breaking Dead DLC is $5 USD on all consoles, and $3 USD as an in-game purchase for the iOS and Android releases; subject to regional pricing.<ref name=":Xbox Store DLC Page">https://www.xbox.com/en-AU/games/store/breaking-dead-dlc/9MTKX7GDJKF1/0010</ref><ref name=":PlayStation Store DLC Page">https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0097-CUSA10727_00-BREAKINGDEAD0000</ref><ref name=":Nintendo Store DLC Page">https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/breaking-dead-70050000012641-switch/</ref><ref name=":App Store Game Page">https://apps.apple.com/us/app/graveyard-keeper/id1461238719</ref><ref name=":Play Store Game Page">https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tinybuild.graveyardkeeper</ref>


==Releases==
Breaking Dead was first teased on October 25th, 2018 on Steam; The teaser was a still image that read: "5 DAYS until resurrection"<ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 1">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151967007</ref> An image was posted each following day, counting down from 5.<ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 2">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151966949</ref><ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 3">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151966894</ref><ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 4">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151966839</ref><ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 5">https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3929910003151966781</ref> 
The post on October 27th had 2 clarifying notes: "No, we're not teasing a console release." and "The thing that is coming is related to the pictures you see."<ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 3"/>
The post on October 29th showed clear artwork of a zombie.<ref name=":Steam News Post Teaser 5"/><br>

Breaking Dead was released on October 30th 2018 on Steam as a free expansion integrated into the base-game.<ref name=":Steam News Release Post" />
The DLC was released as a paid expansion for: the Xbox One & Series X|S on May 30th 2019;<ref name=":Xbox Store DLC Page" /> the PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android on June 27th 2019 alongside the base-game.<ref name=":PlayStation Store DLC Page" /><ref name=":Nintendo Store DLC Page" /><ref name=":App Store Game Page" /><ref name=":Play Store Game Page" />
